description: We are here to challenge you
summary:
**LUNARVERSE – Explore, Build, Survive!**

LUNARVERSE is an interactive 3D space adventure game designed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 – Challenge 3: Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.

The game takes players into a virtual space environment where they can explore and manage a lunar or Martian outpost through multiple mini-games and missions. Players can choose different challenges involving oxygen management, energy conservation, food production, radiation protection, water recycling and astronaut safety.

Each mission presents a unique problem that requires players to make smart decisions, manage limited resources and complete objectives. The game aims to make space science more engaging and help students understand the real challenges of living and working beyond Earth.

**Our vision is to turn space exploration into an interactive learning adventure!**
